correctness.rationale: On a=0, H=cos x+cos y is conserved. Using the stated exact mechanical period T(h)=4K(sqrt(1-h^2/4)) and orbit average <cos y>=h/2 gives Delta z=bT(h)(1-h) with no approximation. Subtracting the zero-mean oscillatory part through the periodic circle cohomological equation yields the smooth annular change zeta=z-b psi and the exact linear flow with frequencies Omega(h) and b(1-h). Differentiating the integral representation gives strict positive-energy monotonicity, and its endpoint limits give the stated range. Dense irrational linear flows force any continuous first integral to be constant on irrational energy tori, and continuity extends this to rational tori, so it factors through H. The negative-energy symmetry and branch monodromy follow consistently. The package's numerical script is only a sanity check and is not needed for the proof.
